big_picture: August activity weakened while September inflation remained above 6%. Budget cuts and a budget decree for next year added a fiscal story ahead of the next rate decision.

top_stories.title: Activity contracted in August
top_stories.what_happened: DANE's activity index fell 0.04% from a year earlier and 3.11% from July after seasonal adjustment; year-to-date output still grew 2.27%.
top_stories.why_it_matters: One weak month does not establish a continuing recession, while inflation above target complicates the policy backdrop.

top_stories.title: A spending cut now and next year’s budget by decree
top_stories.what_happened: The spending-cut decree reduces 2026 appropriations by COP 13.81 trillion (Decreto 1585), while the next budget decree sets 2027 revenue and spending at COP 634.95 trillion (Decreto 1599).
top_stories.why_it_matters: Funding for commitments already legally formalized is protected; this is not proof of cash savings. The government cites a failure to reconcile Congress's two budget texts.
top_stories.who_is_affected: Public agencies, contractors and people receiving public services.

top_stories.title: Security-purchase transparency remains disputed
top_stories.what_happened: Three lawmakers asked to shelve the public-order bill over implementation and oversight concerns (PL 433 Cámara / 296 Senado).
top_stories.why_it_matters: The revised clause removed explicit nonpublication language but kept a reserved-procurement reference. The October 21 session was scheduled, but no certified result or adopted text had been established.
top_stories.who_is_affected: Security agencies, suppliers and people monitoring public spending.

our_calls: No calls or resolutions this week. The historical public record is 4 right-side calls out of 6; the internal record is 2 of 3. None were open by Friday. These small samples do not establish calibration.
